# FRONTEND BUILD PROMPT — <SITE NAME>

You are building ONLY the front-end UI. The backend exists and is final — do NOT
recreate any server logic, data, or calculations. Deliver a complete, polished,
production-ready UI in this single generation; do not ask questions.

> **One-shot, paid-platform-ready template.** `backend-agent` (Agent 3) fills
> every section from the live backend it just built. Paste the finished prompt
> into v0 / Lovable / Replit / Bolt.new / Builder.io.

## 1. One-shot directive
Restate: UI only; the backend is final and must not be recreated; complete,
polished, production-ready output in a single generation; no questions.

## 2. Brand & design system
- Palette (exact hex values), typography (families, weights, type scale), spacing
  scale, corner radii, elevation/shadows, tone/voice.
- The finished product must look like a top web-development firm built it.

## 3. Page-by-page specification
Every page → every section → every component → every button and its **exact
action**. Include loading, empty, and error states for anything data-driven.

## 4. API binding contract
The exact endpoint table from the backend (relative paths), with request/response
shapes. **RULE: real fetches only — ZERO mock data in the final output.**

## 5. Responsive & accessibility
- Mobile-first breakpoints (list them) and fluid layout rules.
- Keyboard navigation, visible focus states, ARIA where needed, WCAG AA contrast.

## 6. Revenue surfaces
- Ad-slot containers with explicit DOM IDs and dimensions.
- Affiliate CTA placements. Paid-tier upsell touchpoints.

## 7. Assets & imagery direction
Image style, sources/placeholders, icon set, illustration/photography direction,
favicon, and social/OG image guidance.

## 8. Export constraints
- Output must build to **static assets** deployable on Cloudflare Pages (e.g.
  Vite / static export). No server-only Node APIs. Keep dependencies lean
  (paid-token efficiency).

## 9. Definition of done checklist
- [ ] Every page and state implemented and polished.
- [ ] Every button wired to the real endpoint; zero mock data.
- [ ] Responsive + keyboard-accessible + AA contrast.
- [ ] Revenue surfaces present with correct IDs.
- [ ] Builds to static assets for Cloudflare Pages.
